package.description: Standalone GeoD command-line tool for parameterized GeoTIFF and GeoJSON acquisition.

en-US.description: Standalone GeoD command-line tool for parameterized GeoTIFF and GeoJSON acquisition.
en-US.longDescription:
GeoD CLI accepts structured JSON requests to plan data acquisition, download GeoTIFF and GeoJSON data bundles, and inspect their manifests and hashes.
Data acquisition does not require the GeoD desktop application, Rust, Node.js, or GDAL. Optional GeoStyle import and browser rendering require a compatible GeoStyle service, Node.js 22 or later, and Chrome or Edge; these are not included in this package.
Version 0.1.1 is the first public Windows x64 preview. Map data is downloaded separately from the configured providers.
en-US.name: GeoD CLI
